# Horizon Airs Split

> Horizon Airs Split offers panoramic gyrocopter flights over Dalmatia, Croatia, making it one of the most unique sightseeing experiences in Split. Operating from Split Harbor (coastal routes) and Piket Airfield near Sinj (mountain routes), the company provides 18 different aerial tour routes ranging from a 15-minute Split Skyline Flight (€75) to a 2-hour Royal Adriatic Flight (€470) covering Brač, Hvar, Vis, and the famous Blue Cave on Biševo. All flights use AutoGyro Cavalon gyrocopters — the safest ultralight aircraft in the world — piloted by EASA and CCAA-certified professionals. Gyrocopters fly at 300–1500m altitude at 80–130 km/h with open cockpits, giving passengers an unobstructed 360° panoramic view. Flights operate daily 08:00–20:00, weather permitting.

## Aircraft

AutoGyro Cavalon gyrocopter with Rotax 914 engine. Two seats (pilot + 1 passenger). Open cockpit for unobstructed 360° views. Cannot stall or spin — autorotation ensures safe landing even with engine failure. Regular 25, 100, 200, and 500-hour maintenance inspections.

## Safety & Certifications

- EASA (European Union Aviation Safety Agency) compliant
- CCAA (Croatian Civil Aviation Agency) certified
- All pilots are licensed professionals
- Maximum passenger weight: 115 kg (253 lbs)
- Equipment provided: helmet, communication system, safety gear

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is a gyrocopter?**
A gyrocopter (autogyro) combines the best of helicopters and airplanes. The rotor spins freely via airflow (not engine-powered), enabling extremely stable flight. Even with engine failure, autorotation allows safe landing — making gyrocopters one of the safest aircraft ever produced.

**How safe is a gyrocopter?**
Very safe. Gyrocopters fly stably and predictably. In engine failure, the rotor continues spinning freely, enabling safe descent. Used worldwide in flight schools and aerial patrols.

**How many passengers per gyrocopter?**
Two seats: one pilot, one passenger. For couples or groups, synchronized fleet flights are available so you fly side by side.

**What altitude do you fly at?**
Typically 300–600 meters, depending on route and conditions, providing optimal views of Dalmatia's coastline and islands.

**Do I need flying experience?**
No experience needed. The pilot handles everything and briefs you before takeoff. Your only job is enjoying the view.

**How do I book?**
Book directly at flyabovesplit.com. Select your preferred date and route, receive confirmation and deposit payment instructions.

**Cancellation policy?**
Cancel or change up to 72 hours before — full refund. Within 72 hours, deposit is retained. Weather cancellations are fully refunded or rescheduled.

**Can I record the flight?**
We offer professional GoPro Hero and GoPro 360 recording for €20 (free on 90+ min flights). Personal phones not recommended due to wind risk.

**What should I bring?**
Sunglasses and a light jacket. Helmet, communication system, and safety equipment are provided.

**Do you offer gift vouchers?**
Yes — personalized vouchers valid 12 months, ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or corporate gifts.

## About Split, Croatia

Split is Croatia's second-largest city and the gateway to the Dalmatian islands. Home to the UNESCO-listed Diocletian's Palace (built 305 AD), Split attracts millions of tourists annually. The city offers stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and world-class restaurants. A gyrocopter flight provides the only way to see Split, Diocletian's Palace, and the surrounding islands of Brač, Hvar, Vis, and Šolta in a single breathtaking experience — combining adventure with panoramic coastal views that no boat tour or bus excursion can match.
